structure.unit: Virginia Property and Casualty Insurance Guaranty Association

law.text: The purpose of this article is to provide directions and guidelines for the control and use of funds provided pursuant to § 38.2-225, obtained through secured borrowings made pursuant to subdivision B 7 of § 38.2-1606, or obtained from sources of funds not specified in Article 1 (§ 38.2-1600 et seq.) of this chapter.
